title: First-vertex functor from opposite simplex chains preserves cocone spaces
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, ordinary nerves, quasicategories, functor simplicial sets, constant diagrams and right-pinched Kan mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], with universes enlarged as necessary. Let $C$ be any small ordinary category. For any small simplicial set $X$, let $\mathsf S(X)$ be the ordinary category whose objects are all simplices $\sigma:\Delta^n\to X$, including degenerate simplices, and whose morphisms $\sigma\to\tau$ are monotone maps $\alpha:[n]\to[m]$ with $\tau\Delta(\alpha)=\sigma$; composition is composition of the monotone maps. The first-vertex functor $v_C:\mathsf S(N(C))^{\mathrm{op}}\to C$ sends the simplex $(c_0\to\cdots\to c_n)$ to $c_0$. A morphism in the opposite simplex category from a chain $\tau:[m]\to C$ to a chain $\sigma:[n]\to C$, represented by $\alpha:[n]\to[m]$ with $\tau\alpha=\sigma$, is sent to the arrow $\tau(0)\to\tau(\alpha(0))=\sigma(0)$. For every quasicategory $\mathcal E$, every map $p:N(C)\to\mathcal E$ and every vertex $T\in\mathcal E$, restriction itself induces an equivalence of Kan complexes
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(N(C),\mathcal E)}(p,\Delta_{N(C)}T)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(N(\mathsf S(N(C))^{\mathrm{op}}),\mathcal E)}(pN(v_C),\Delta_{N(\mathsf S(N(C))^{\mathrm{op}})}T).$$
No colimit-existence assumption on $\mathcal E$ is made, and $C$ may be empty.

mathlib_searches.query: The first vertex functor from the opposite category of simplices of the nerve of an ordinary category is homotopy cofinal
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concern strict Segal nerves, the fact that nerves are quasicategories, reflective nerveFunctor and truncated nerve adjunction formulas; none concerns first-vertex cofinality.

mathlib_searches.query: opposite simplex category first vertex functor preserves spaces of cocones
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concern ordinary cones/cocones and passage to opposites, SSet.opFunctor and SimplicialObject.opFunctor; none gives the homotopy-cofinal first-vertex map.

CategoryTheory.Functor.Final and final_of_adjunction, final_of_isRightAdjoint, etc. Read Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Limits/Final.lean:92-97: Final requires connected comma categories, not weakly contractible nerves, so it does not imply the required infinity-categorical assertion.
Six hits: initial/final vertices of 2-simplices in HomotopyCat.lean, a graph dart and a convex standard-simplex formula. No first-vertex cofinality theorem.
